bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(pwd -P)" = "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = true
src=f04b70d529f2993656c54b8e7a2b81bc24b620b7
base="$(pwd -P)"
test -d .worktrees || mkdir .worktrees
test "$(realpath .worktrees)" = "$base/.worktrees"
wt="$base/.worktrees/notice-live-20261127"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$src" >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src"
if test ! -d "$wt";then git worktree add --detach "$wt" "$src" >/dev/null;fi
test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$src"
test -z "$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain)"
test "$(realpath "$wt")" = "$base/.worktrees/notice-live-20261127"
docker build -q --pull=false -f "$wt/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-stage-20261127 "$wt" >/dev/null
test -n "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-stage-20261127)"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Config.User}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-stage-20261127)" = node
docker run --rm --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-stage-20261127 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
echo NOTICE_STAGE_IMAGE_BUILT=PASS
